notes.title: Little Garden v0.9!
notes.content:
NEW UPDATE!

We know we were quiet for a long time and we are sorry about it.

To apologize, we are sharing our new update with you.

I hope you will enjoy playing the new version of the game.

You can join our Discord channel to share the bugs you have experienced or give feedback.

Also, you can follow our social media accounts to hear more about new updates.

Now, let’s talk about what is new in Little Garden:

New interface!

We have changed the UI design in the alpha version completely since It did not fit the general concept of the game. The new UI design is more proper in terms of user experience. We renewed the color palette by supporting it with animations to make it look better in general design.

Mushroom Island!

We added a new island next to the one where you can grow plants. Instead of the first island, now you can plant lots of different mushrooms and cook new food.

New plants!

6 new plants have been added to the game and the plants on the alpha version now have more detailed animations.

Growing mechanisms have changed!

Turn-based growing mechanisms have now changed into real-time mechanisms.

Restaurant!

Instead of the mission system in the alpha version, now there is a restaurant where you can serve your customers up to your imagination. You can earn more depending on the restaurant’s design and customer satisfaction and grow your island. Make sure that you have enough plants in your silo to cook what your customers want.

Random things happening!

Now you need to protect your plants when they are growing up by chasing the birds and sending away the dangerous fishes around the island! You can lose your most precious carrot in your field if they attack.

We will share the improved version of Little Garden 1.0 with you soon. We need your support in this period. You can share Little Garden on social media and join our discord to become a part of our community.
